title: Mimir
description: Mimir on mim01-03, the long-term metrics store behind both Prometheus replicas (Grafana's default datasource): health checks mirroring the alerts, ingestion and HA dedup, series vs limits, ingester TSDB and block shipping, compactor and backfill uploads, store-gateway, queries, S3 on Ceph RGW, rings, processes and logs.

panels.title: Checks
panels.description: Mimir's invariants, the same ones the metrics alert group watches: TargetDown, MimirRingMembersMissing (ingester/store-gateway/compactor/distributor rings with fewer ACTIVE members than Mimir targets), MimirRingUnhealthy, MimirDiscardingSamples (the HA dedup's replicas_did_not_match excluded), PrometheusRemoteWriteFailing / -Behind (> 300 s), MimirBlockUploadFailures (15 m), MimirCompactorNotRunning (24 h), MimirRGWBackendDown and MimirVIPNotHeldOnce. 'one replica elected' has no alert: the HA tracker must accept exactly one Prometheus.

targets.expr: (max(max by (host) (prometheus_remote_storage_highest_timestamp_in_seconds{job="prometheus"} - ignoring(remote_name, url) group_right prometheus_remote_storage_queue_highest_sent_timestamp_seconds{job="prometheus"})) or vector(0)) < bool 300

panels.title: Accepted Prometheus
panels.description: The replica (__replica__) whose samples the HA tracker stores; the other one's pushes are answered 202 and dropped. It fails over when the elected replica sends nothing for 30 s (ha_tracker failover timeout).

panels.title: VIP on
panels.description: The Mimir VM holding keepalived's VIP 10.13.11.103: Prometheus pushes and Grafana queries arrive there (its distributor and query-frontend fan out to all three).

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Mimir version(s) running; two names = a rolling upgrade in progress.

panels.title: Active series
panels.description: Series that received a sample recently (per ingester; RF 3 means every ingester holds all of them).

panels.title: of the series limit
panels.description: Active series against max_global_series_per_user (metrics_settings.max_series, as each ingester enforces it). At 100 % new series are rejected (discarded reason per_user_series_limit).

panels.title: Samples / s stored
panels.description: Samples the distributors accept after the HA dedup (one Prometheus' worth).

panels.title: Last compaction
panels.description: Since the newest successful compactor run on any VM (every hour; alert MimirCompactorNotRunning after 24 h).

panels.title: Last block shipped
panels.description: Since an ingester last uploaded a 2 h TSDB block to S3 (normally every 2 h).

panels.title: S3 bucket mimir
panels.description: Size of the RGW bucket holding every block (retention 396 d), from the Ceph RGW bucket stats.

panels.title: Rejected / failed in range
panels.description: Counts over the time range. Pushes 5xx: Prometheus retries them (a restart or ring change). Query errors: queries that failed inside a querier (cancelled ones not counted).

panels.title: Samples in / stored / deduplicated
panels.description: Samples/s at the distributors. pushed ≈ stored + dropped: both Prometheus replicas send everything, the HA tracker keeps one. Any 'discarded' line is a limit or validation rejection.

panels.title: Pushes by Mimir and response
panels.description: remote_write requests per Mimir: the VIP holder gets them all. 200 = elected replica stored, 202 = the other replica's push acknowledged and dropped (HA dedup), 4xx = rejected (limits), 5xx = failed (Prometheus retries).

panels.title: Push latency
panels.description: remote_write request duration at the receiving Mimir: distributor + write to all three ingesters (quorum 2 of 3).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, host) (rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="mimir", host=~"$host", route="api_v1_push"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, host) (rate(cortex_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="mimir", host=~"$host", route="api_v1_push"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Elected Prometheus replica
panels.description: Which Prometheus the HA tracker accepted when. A switch means the elected one stopped pushing for 30 s (restart, network); a gap of ~30 s in the data at that moment is normal.

panels.title: HA tracker elections and sample age
panels.description: Replica changes per hour (each distributor counts them; the max is shown). Sample age: how old the samples are when they reach the distributor (scrape → remote_write queue → push). It rises while Prometheus catches up after an outage.

panels.title: Prometheus → Mimir remote_write
panels.description: The senders' side: how far each Prometheus is behind (alert PrometheusRemoteWriteBehind at 300 s) and samples it failed or retried (5xx/429 from Mimir). Details: Prometheus dashboard.

panels.title: Distributor load and rejections
panels.description: Pushes being processed now, and pushes refused by an instance limit (max_inflight_push_requests: 2000 per distributor, 30000 per ingester).

panels.title: Ingestion rate per Mimir
panels.description: Each distributor's own sliding-window rate (the VIP holder takes them all) and the samples each ingester appends (RF 3: each one appends every stored sample). The tenant's ingestion_rate limit is 300k samples/s (metrics_settings).

panels.title: Discarded samples by reason
panels.description: Samples Mimir rejected (alert MimirDiscardingSamples): rate_limited / per_user_series_limit (raise metrics_settings), sample-out-of-order / sample-too-old (older than the head and the 10 m out-of-order window), label validation. The HA dedup's replicas_did_not_match is left out. Only counted when it happens, so empty is the healthy state.

panels.title: Active series vs limit
panels.description: Active series per ingester (all three hold every series: RF 3 on 3 ingesters) against the per-tenant limit as the ingesters enforce it.

panels.title: Series churn
panels.description: New series per second (a new target, a relabel, a label value that changes) and series dropped at head compaction (gone for over an hour). Big spikes after a deploy point at a label that churns.

panels.title: In-memory series and head span
panels.description: Series in each ingester's head (active ones plus those that stopped within the last 1-3 h) and the time the head covers: it grows to 3 h and drops to 1 h at each 2 h head compaction.

panels.title: Ingester TSDB, WAL and blocks to S3
Head chunks and samples appended
panels.description: Chunks held in each ingester's head, and samples appended per second (and appends that failed: out of bounds, out of order, series limit).

panels.title: WAL fsync and append latency
panels.description: The WAL (/var/lib/metrics/mimir/tsdb on the VM's Ceph RBD disk) is fsynced at segment cuts and checkpoints, so the fsync line has gaps; commit p99 is what each push waits for in the ingester.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(cortex_ingester_tsdb_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_sum{job="mimir", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (host) (rate(cortex_ingester_tsdb_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_count{job="mimir", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TSDB and WAL failures
panels.description: Per hour. Any of these is a disk or data problem on that ingester (the other two still hold every series).

panels.title: Head compactions and blocks shipped
panels.description: Per hour: each ingester cuts a 2 h block from its head every 2 h and ships it to the bucket (alert MimirBlockUploadFailures). The three copies (RF 3) are merged by the compactor.

panels.title: Since last block shipped
panels.description: Time since each ingester's last successful upload (sawtooth up to ~2 h), and the age of its oldest local block not yet in S3 (0 = all shipped).

targets.expr: (time() - max by (host) (cortex_ingester_oldest_unshipped_block_timestamp_seconds{job="mimir", host=~"$host"} > 0)) or max by (host) (cortex_ingester_oldest_unshipped_block_timestamp_seconds{job="mimir", host=~"$host"}) * 0

panels.title: Out-of-order samples
panels.description: Samples older than the head's newest that were still accepted thanks to out_of_order_time_window (10 m: a replica failover resends a little older data), and those rejected for being too old. History backfills don't go through here: they are uploaded as blocks (Compactor row).

panels.title: Compactor per VM
panels.description: Each Mimir runs a compactor that owns a share of the jobs (compactor ring), hourly. Last run / Last cleanup: since its last successful compaction pass and bucket cleanup (deletes blocks marked for deletion, applies the 396 d retention, rewrites the bucket index). Counts are over the time range.

panels.title: Blocks compacted and deleted
panels.description: Per hour, all compactors. Compaction merges the three ingesters' copies and smaller blocks (2 h → 12 h → 24 h); the sources are marked and deleted ~12 h later. retention: past 396 d. no-compact: a block the compactor gave up on (look at the logs).

panels.title: Blocks in the bucket
panels.description: Blocks the compactor sees in the bucket (largest view of the three): loaded = live blocks, marked-for-deletion = waiting for cleanup. failed / corrupted = broken meta.json.

panels.title: Block uploads (backfill)
panels.description: History uploaded as whole blocks with `mimirtool backfill` (compactor_block_upload_enabled): the InfluxDB history of the WLC and Proxmox series. Each block is started, its files sent, then validated by the compactor and added to the bucket. Flat at 0 while no backfill runs.

panels.title: Backfill bytes and validation time
panels.description: Bytes received by the block-upload API per hour and how long the compactor took to validate an uploaded block.

panels.title: Compaction job duration
panels.description: How long a compaction job takes (download, merge, upload) and the compactor's garbage collection of superseded blocks.

panels.title: Blocks loaded
panels.description: Blocks each store-gateway serves (store-gateway ring, replication factor 3: normally every gateway loads every block; counts differ for a while after compaction) and their size. Queries reaching back past 12 h read these.

panels.title: Block loads and sync
panels.description: Blocks loaded/dropped as the compactor replaces them, and time since each store-gateway last synced the bucket index (every 15 min).

panels.title: Store-gateway Series latency
panels.description: Series requests from the queriers (only for queries reaching back past 12 h).

panels.title: Queries per second by route
panels.description: Grafana's (and lylat-obs') requests through the query-frontend, by API route. Nothing queries Mimir unless a dashboard is open (alerting runs on the Prometheus replicas).

panels.title: Query latency
panels.description: At the query-frontend: queue wait + execution by the queriers (split by day, sharded) + merge.

panels.title: Query errors
panels.description: Non-2xx answers at the frontend (4xx: bad query or limit, 5xx/429: overloaded or failed), queries that failed inside a querier (ERROR_CANCELED = Grafana gave up / the panel was closed, usually harmless) and queries refused by a per-query limit.

panels.title: Scheduler queue
panels.description: Queries waiting for a querier in each query-scheduler (ring discovery: every frontend uses all three). Queue limit 800 per tenant (max_outstanding_requests_per_tenant); a long wait means the queriers are saturated.

panels.title: Data read by queries
panels.description: Series and bytes the queriers fetched from ingesters and store-gateways.

panels.title: Queries by type and ruler
panels.description: Queries per second by kind at the frontend. The ruler runs (target all) but holds no rules: alerting and recording rules are in Prometheus, so ruler managers stays 0.

panels.title: S3 operations by component
panels.description: Requests to the bucket: the ingesters upload, the compactor lists/reads/uploads/deletes, store-gateways and queriers read. ruler-storage (local filesystem) is left out.

panels.title: S3 operation latency (p99)
panels.description: Per component and operation, all VMs. Uploads of big compacted blocks take seconds; get/exists/attributes should be a few ms.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, component, operation) (rate(thanos_objstore_bucket_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job="mimir", host=~"$host", component!="ruler-storage"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: S3 operation failures
panels.description: Failed bucket operations (not-found answers to exists/get don't count). Failures together with haproxy showing no RGW = the RGWs are down (alert MimirRGWBackendDown).

panels.title: RGWs per haproxy
panels.description: haproxy on each Mimir VM (127.0.0.1:7480) health-checks the three RGWs; Mimir's S3 client reaches the bucket only through it.

targets.expr: max by (host, server) (haproxy_server_status{job="haproxy-mimir", proxy="rgw", state="UP", host=~"$host"})

panels.title: haproxy → RGW responses and latency
panels.description: HTTP answers from the RGWs per second (4xx are mostly 404s to exists checks: normal), haproxy's average response time over its last 1024 requests, and connection errors/retries.

targets.expr: sum by (host) (rate(haproxy_backend_connection_errors_total{job="haproxy-mimir", proxy="rgw", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(haproxy_backend_retry_warnings_total{job="haproxy-mimir", proxy="rgw", host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Bucket mimir
panels.description: The RGW bucket (Ceph RGW bucket stats via the node_exporter textfile on the PVE nodes).

panels.title: Ring members by state
panels.description: Members of every hash ring as the Mimir that sees fewest reports them (one row per ring). All three ACTIVE is healthy. Unhealthy = a member stopped heartbeating (a rebuilt VM's old entry: forget it on /ingester/ring); LEAVING/JOINING during restarts.

panels.title: ACTIVE members per ring
panels.description: Over time: a dip is a Mimir restart (alert MimirRingMembersMissing after 10 m).

panels.title: memberlist
panels.description: The gossip that carries every ring and the HA tracker state (port 7946 on the HA VLAN, cluster label lylat-mimir). Members should be 3 everywhere; health score > 0 means the node misses probes.

panels.title: Mimir CPU
panels.description: CPU of the Mimir process (1 = one core).

panels.title: Mimir memory
panels.description: The head (every series, RF 3) lives in memory: RSS grows with active series.

panels.title: Goroutines and file descriptors
panels.description: Steadily climbing goroutines = something stuck (hung S3 or gRPC calls).

panels.title: VM disk used (/)
panels.description: Root filesystem (60 GB) of each VM: /var/lib/metrics/mimir holds the WAL, the last 13 h of blocks, the store-gateway's index headers and the compactor's scratch space.

targets.expr: 1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node", role="metrics", host=~"$host", mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node", role="metrics", host=~"$host", mountpoint="/"}
sum by (host) (cortex_ingester_tsdb_storage_blocks_bytes{job="mimir", host=~"$host"}) / max by (host) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node", role="metrics", host=~"$host", mountpoint="/"})

panels.title: Mimir warnings and errors per VM
panels.description: Mimir logs logfmt; Podman stores its stderr with priority err, so the real level comes from the line's level= field. Recurring: store-gateway 'failed to collect on-disk stats' for blocks it just loaded (harmless).

panels.title: Mimir log lines by level
panels.description: All Mimir log lines by their logfmt level.
